privateLinkUrl.description: PrivateLink URL to access OpenSearch Dashboards, if PrivateLink is enabled for the cluster.

version.description:
Version of dashboard to run on the cluster. Available versions:
  • `2.19.5`
  • `3.5.0`
  • `2.19.6`
  • `3.6.0`

nodes.description: List of non-deleted nodes in the data centre

deletedNodes.description: List of deleted nodes in the data centre

awsSettings.description: AWS specific settings for the Data Centre. Cannot be provided with GCP or Azure settings.
awsSettings.x-insta-comment: due to a bug with the terraform provider openapi plugin this has to be a list instead of a nested object. Also has to be computed because terraform defaults lists to empty arrays when skipped, whereas the API returns null

tagManagementEnabled.description: (Optional) Enable tag management for the data centre, allowing you to create, update and delete custom tags on the data centre via Instaclustr Terraform Provider v2, Cluster Management API or Management Console. Tag management is only available for RIYOA clusters and cannot be disabled once enabled. If not specified, the current value will remain unchanged.

privateLinkEndpointServiceName.description: PrivateLink Endpoint Service name. Only applicable to data centres with PrivateLink enabled.

networks.description: All network CIDR blocks for this data centre, including the primary network and any expanded secondary CIDRs.

privateLinkRestApiUrl.description: PrivateLink REST API URL. Only applicable to data centres with PrivateLink enabled.

network.description: The private network address block for the Data Centre specified using CIDR address notation. The network must have a prefix length between `/16` and `/26` and must be part of a private address space.

tags.description: List of tags to apply to the Data Centre. Tags are metadata labels which allow you to identify, categorize and filter clusters. This can be useful for grouping together clusters into applications, environments, or any category that you require. Note: Tags will be returned sorted by key in alphabetical order regardless of input order. Terraform users: `tag` is not supported in terraform lifecycle `ignore_changes`.

zeroInboundAccess.description: Zero Inbound Access gateways eliminate the requirement for any public IP addresses in cluster deployment.

gcpSettings.description: GCP specific settings for the Data Centre. Cannot be provided with AWS or Azure settings.

numberOfRacks.description: Number of racks to use when allocating data nodes.

nodes.description: List of non-deleted nodes in the data centre

azureSettings.description: Azure specific settings for the Data Centre. Cannot be provided with AWS or GCP settings.

name.description: A logical name for the data centre within a cluster. These names must be unique in the cluster.

id.description: ID of the Cluster Data Centre.

region.description: Region of the Data Centre. See the description for node size for a compatible Data Centre for a given node size.

privateLink.description: Create a PrivateLink enabled cluster, see [PrivateLink](https://www.instaclustr.com/support/documentation/useful-information/privatelink/).
privateLink.x-insta-comment: IAM Principal ARN becomes a separate resource which has its own endpoint for provisioning.

providerAccountName.description: For customers running in their own account. Your provider account can be found on the Create Cluster page on the Instaclustr Console, or the "Provider Account" property on any existing cluster. For customers provisioning on Instaclustr's cloud provider accounts, this property may be omitted.

dedicatedMasterNodes.description: This is an optional boolean parameter used to scale the load of the data node by having 3 dedicated master nodes for a particular cluster. We recommend selecting this to true for clusters with 9 and above nodes.

masterNodeSize.description: Only to be included if the if dedicatedMasterNodes is set to true. See Available cluster node sizes in Provisioning API

openSearchDashboardsNodeSize.description: This is an optional string parameter to used to define the OpenSearch Dashboards node size. Only to be included if wish to add an OpenSearch Dashboards node to the cluster. See Available cluster node sizes in Provisioning API

indexManagementPlugin.description: Enables Index Management Plugin. This helps automate recurring index management activities.

anomalyDetectionPlugin.description: Enables the Anomaly Detection Plugin. This allows for the detection of unusual or anomalous data points in your time-series data. Supported on OpenSearch 2.x for versions >= 2.4.0 and 1.x for versions >= 1.3.7

sqlPlugin.description: Enables the SQL Plugin. This allows you to query you indices with SQL as an alternative to the OpenSearch Query DSL. Supported on OpenSearch 2.x for versions >= 2.4.0 and 1.x for versions >= 1.3.7

asynchronousSearchPlugin.description: Enables the Anomaly Detection Plugin. This allows you to submit queries to be completed asynchronously. Supported on OpenSearch 2.x for versions >= 2.4.0 and 1.x for versions 1.3.7

publicEndpoint.description: Public endpoint to connect clients to the cluster. Not applicable to Private IP only clusters.

leaderClusterAccount.description: The leader cluster account ID for a Cross Cluster Replication enabled follower cluster. This requires crossClusterReplicationPlugin to be set to true.

searchableSnapshots.description: Enable searchable snapshots. Available only for OpenSearch versions 2.7.0 or higher.

vectorIndexBuilder.description: Remote Vector Index Builder settings. When provided, a dedicated GPU host is provisioned.

ingestNodesLoadBalancerConnectionUrl.description: URL of the Ingest Nodes specific Network Load Balancer if a load balancer is enabled for the cluster. Balances request loads against nodes with the ingest role. Recommended for clusters with dedicated ingest nodes.

licenseSecretNamePrefix.description: Specifies the prefix path to the Portal26 license in Secrets Manager.  For example if you have specify `prefix1`, you must store the `titaniam.license` secret in AWS Secrets Manager with the secret key `prefix1titaniam.licence` in AWS, and `prefix1titaniam-license` on GCP.

privateNetworkCluster.description: Creates the cluster with private network only, see [Private Network Clusters](https://www.instaclustr.com/support/documentation/useful-information/private-network-clusters/).

restoreSettings.description: Triggers a restore operation when provided during cluster creation. Contains the settings for the restore request.

resizeSettings.description: Settings to determine how resize requests will be performed for the cluster.

id.description: ID of the cluster.

gcpSecretsManagerServiceAccount.description: Service Account that has read-only access to GCP Secrets Manager.

anonymousAuthEnabled.description: Enable anonymous authentication. Allows unauthenticated requests with restricted  permissions. Requires Private Network Cluster. Not available when PCI compliance mode is enabled.

defaultUserPassword.description: Password of the default user created for the OpenSearch cluster.

loadBalancerConnectionUrl.description: URL of the Network Load Balancer if a load balancer is enabled for the cluster. Balances request loads against all nodes in the cluster except for ingest nodes.

gcpInstanceServiceAccount.description: Service account of the instance for the nodes in the OpenSearch cluster. This service account principal needs to be provided access to the service account matching `gcpSecretsManagerServiceAccount` for OpenSearch to successfully boot up with Portal26.

awsInstanceRoleArn.description: ARN of the instance role for the nodes in the OpenSearch cluster. This ARN needs to be trusted by the role matching `awsSecretsManagerIamRoleArn` for OpenSearch to successfully boot up with Portal26.

nodeTypeAttributesEnabled.description: Enable managed node_type attributes. Requires the OPENSEARCH_NODE_TYPE_ATTRIBUTES account feature. Exactly one data-role node per rack is assigned node_type=metadata and all remaining data-role nodes are assigned node_type=data.

leaderClusterId.description: Specifies the leader cluster ID for a Cross Cluster Replication enabled follower cluster. This requires crossClusterReplicationPlugin to be set to true. Not defining this will make the cluster a leader cluster if crossClusterReplicationPlugin is set to true.

opensearchMajorVersion.description: Major version of OpenSearch to run on the cluster. Must be provided if `opensearchVersion` is not provided.

enableBidirectionalReplication.description: When true, provisions the new follower with bi-directional OpenSearch cross-cluster replication against the specified leader. On GET, true when this cluster is a bi-directional follower of its leader.

id.description: ID of the Cluster Data Centre.

awsSettings.description: AWS specific settings for the Data Centre. Cannot be provided with GCP or Azure settings.
awsSettings.x-insta-comment: See x-insta-comment on awsSettings in AllProviderSpecificSettingsV2

tagManagementEnabled.description: (Optional) Enable tag management for the data centre, allowing you to create, update and delete custom tags on the data centre via Instaclustr Terraform Provider v2, Cluster Management API or Management Console. Tag management is only available for RIYOA clusters and cannot be disabled once enabled. If not specified, the current value will remain unchanged.

customSubjectAlternativeNames.description: List of Subject Alternative Names FQDNs as per RFC 1035.  Used by the applications with self signed certificates in keystores of nodes in the datacenter.

tags.description: List of tags to apply to the Data Centre. Tags are metadata labels which allow you to identify, categorize and filter clusters. This can be useful for grouping together clusters into applications, environments, or any category that you require. Note: Tags will be returned sorted by key in alphabetical order regardless of input order. Terraform users: `tag` is not supported in terraform lifecycle `ignore_changes`.

gcpSettings.description: GCP specific settings for the Data Centre. Cannot be provided with AWS or Azure settings.

nodes.description: List of non-deleted nodes in the data centre

privateConnectivity.description: Create a Private Connectivity enabled cluster

azureSettings.description: Azure specific settings for the Data Centre. Cannot be provided with AWS or GCP settings.

name.description: A logical name for the data centre within a cluster. These names must be unique in the cluster.

region.description: Region of the Data Centre. See the description for node size for a compatible Data Centre for a given node size.

providerAccountName.description: For customers running in their own account. Your provider account can be found on the Create Cluster page on the Instaclustr Console, or the "Provider Account" property on any existing cluster. For customers provisioning on Instaclustr's cloud provider accounts, this property may be omitted.

sourceCdcId.description: ID of the original Cluster Data Centre to be forked

network.description: Cluster Data Centre network for the new forked cluster

isPrimaryDataCentre.description: Is this Data centre considered to be the primary (only required if multiple data centres defined).

PostgresqlInterDataCentreReplicationDeta.description: Defines data replication configuration within a Data centre

PostgresqlIntraDataCentreReplicationDeta.description: Defines data replication configuration within a Data centre

clientEncryption.description: Accepts true/false. Enables Client ⇄ Node Encryption.

postgresqlNodeCount.description: The number of PostgreSQL server nodes created. One of which will be the primary while the rest will be replicas

synchronousModeStrict.description: Accepts true/false. Enables synchronous mode strict for clusters with SYNCHRONOUS replication mode.

PostgresqlPrivateConnectivitySettingsV2.description: Settings required for Private Connectivity to be enabled on a cluster.

ebsEncryptionKey.description: ID of a KMS encryption key to encrypt data on nodes. KMS encryption key must be set in Cluster Resources through the Instaclustr Console before provisioning an encrypted Data Centre.

addSecondaryCidrToVpc.description: When true and a custom VPC is specified, the Data Centre's network will be associated as a secondary CIDR block to the VPC. The association will be removed when the Data Centre is deleted. Only valid when customVirtualNetworkId is set and fsxFileSystemMappings are provided for BYO FSx provisioning. Only applicable for PostgreSQL clusters.

customVirtualNetworkId.description: VPC ID into which the Data Centre will be provisioned. The Data Centre's network allocation must match the IPv4 CIDR block of the specified VPC.

storageNetwork.description: The private network address block to be used for the storage network. This is only used for certain node sizes, currently limited to those which use AWS FSx ONTAP: for all other node sizes, this field should not be provided. The network must have a prefix length between /16 and /28, and must be part of a private address range.

fsxFileSystemMappings.description: Mapping of rack names to FSx File System IDs for BYO FSx provisioning. Only applicable for PostgreSQL clusters.

nodeId.description: Node Id of the node in which this reload operation was executed.

PostgresqlReplicationModeEnumV2.description: Create the PostgreSQL cluster with the selected replication mode, see [PostgreSQL replication mode] (https://www.instaclustr.com/support/documentation/postgresql/options/replication-mode/).

password.description: Password of the default PostgreSQL user.

PostgresqlUserSummary.description: Summary of the default PostgreSQL user to be applied to a PostgreSQL cluster.

azurePrivateLink.description: Azure Private Link settings for Kafka. This feature is not generally available. Please contact Instaclustr Support (support@instaclustr.com) for more information.

shotoverProxy.description: Details of the Shotover Proxy nodes provisioned for Private Service Connect.

network.description: The private network address block for the Service Attachment Network with Private Service Connect specified using CIDR address notation. The network must have a prefix length between `/12` and `/22` and must be part of a private address space. If not provided, then the next available network will be used.

PrivateServiceConnectSettingsV2.description: Settings required for Private Service Connect to be enabled on a cluster.

accountName.description: For customers running in their own account. Your provider account can be found on the Create Cluster page on the console, or the “Provider Account” property on any existing cluster. For customers running in Instaclustr account, this property may be omitted.

customVirtualNetworkId.description:
AWS: VPC ID to provision data centre into, cluster network must match the IPv4 CIDR block of the specified VPC.
GCP: Network name or a relative Network or Subnetwork URI e.g. projects/my-project/regions/us-central1/subnetworks/my-subnet, cluster network must match the IPv4 CIDR block of the specified subnet.

tags.description: AWS_VPC, GCP, AZURE and AZURE_AZ only. If specified, the value is a map from tag key to value. For AWS_VPC restrictions, refer to the AWS User Guide. Tags are defined per cluster and will be applied to every instance in the cluster.

resourceGroup.description: AZURE only. If specified, the value is the name for an Azure Resource Group which the resources will be provisioned into.

diskEncryptionKey.description: AWS_VPC only. Specify a KMS encryption key to encrypt data on nodes. KMS encryption key must be set in Account settings before provisioning an encrypted cluster.

ProviderAccountPrimaryKey.description: Provider information including name and account

ebsEncryptionKey.description: ID of a KMS encryption key to encrypt data on nodes. KMS encryption key must be set in Cluster Resources through the Instaclustr Console before provisioning an encrypted Data Centre.

customVirtualNetworkId.description: VPC ID into which the Data Centre will be provisioned. The Data Centre's network allocation must match the IPv4 CIDR block of the specified VPC.

storageNetwork.description: The private network address block to be used for the storage network. This is only used for certain node sizes, currently limited to those which use AWS FSx ONTAP: for all other node sizes, this field should not be provided. The network must have a prefix length between /16 and /28, and must be part of a private address range.

resourceGroup.description: The name of the Azure Resource Group into which the Data Centre will be provisioned.

customVirtualNetworkId.description: VNet ID into which the Data Centre will be provisioned. The VNet must have an available address space for the Data Centre's network allocation to be appended to the VNet. Currently supported for PostgreSQL clusters only.

storageNetwork.description: The private network address block to be used for the storage network. This is only used for certain node sizes, currently limited to those which use Azure NetApp Files: for all other node sizes, this field should not be provided. The network must have a prefix length between /16 and /28, and must be part of a private address range.

customVirtualNetworkId.description: Network name or a relative Network or Subnetwork URI. The Data Centre's network allocation must match the IPv4 CIDR block of the specified subnet. Examples: - Network URI: projects/{riyoa-gcp-project-name}/global/networks/{network-name}. - Network name: {network-name}, equivalent to projects/{riyoa-gcp-project-name}/global/networks/{network-name}. - Same-project subnetwork URI: projects/{riyoa-gcp-project-name}/regions/{region-id}/subnetworks/{subnetwork-name}. - Shared VPC subnetwork URI: projects/{riyoa-gcp-host-project-name}/regions/{region-id}/subnetworks/{subnetwork-name}.

clientEncryption.description: Accepts true/false. Enables Client ⇄ Node Encryption.

description.example: Cluster managed by the integration team.

passwordAndUserAuth.description: Enables Password Authentication and User Authorization.

id.description: ID of the cluster.

replicationFactor.description: The number of replica nodes that should be assigned for each master node.

deletedNodes.description: List of deleted nodes in the data centre

awsSettings.description: AWS specific settings for the Data Centre. Cannot be provided with GCP or Azure settings.

tagManagementEnabled.description: (Optional) Enable tag management for the data centre, allowing you to create, update and delete custom tags on the data centre via Instaclustr Terraform Provider v2, Cluster Management API or Management Console. Tag management is only available for RIYOA clusters and cannot be disabled once enabled. If not specified, the current value will remain unchanged.

networks.description: All network CIDR blocks for this data centre, including the primary network and any expanded secondary CIDRs.

network.description: The private network address block for the Data Centre specified using CIDR address notation. The network must have a prefix length between `/16` and `/26` and must be part of a private address space.

tags.description: List of tags to apply to the Data Centre. Tags are metadata labels which allow you to identify, categorize and filter clusters. This can be useful for grouping together clusters into applications, environments, or any category that you require. Note: Tags will be returned sorted by key in alphabetical order regardless of input order. Terraform users: `tag` is not supported in terraform lifecycle `ignore_changes`.

zeroInboundAccess.description: Zero Inbound Access gateways eliminate the requirement for any public IP addresses in cluster deployment.

gcpSettings.description: GCP specific settings for the Data Centre. Cannot be provided with AWS or Azure settings.

ShotoverProxyDetailsV2.description: Details of the Shotover Proxy nodes provisioned in a Cassandra cluster with Private Link enabled.

SingleApplicationVersionV2.description: Object containing a single application and a version.

SlaTierV2.description: SLA Tier of the cluster. Non-production clusters may receive lower priority support and reduced SLAs. Production tier is not available when using Developer class nodes. See [SLA Tier](https://www.instaclustr.com/support/documentation/useful-information/sla-tier/) for more information.

passwordAuthentication.description: Require clients to provide credentials — a username & API Key — to connect to the Spark Jobserver.

version.description: Adds the specified version of Apache Spark to the Cassandra cluster. Available versions:

storageThroughputMibps.description: Target storage throughput, in MiB/s. Must be one of the values allowed by the storage provider for the filesystem's generation.

StorageResizeResourceTargets.description: Target filesystem capacity, throughput and IOPS to resize an FSxN forked cluster's storage to. Only valid, and required, when shouldResize is true.

description.example: 95th percentile distribution of the metric

aggregation.description: Aggregation over which metric is calculated

name.description: Name of the topic being mirrored

averageLatency.description: Average latency in milliseconds for messages to travel from source to destination topics

averageRate.description: Average record rate for messages to travel from source to destination topics, it is 0 if there are no messages travelling in between

TopicInfo.description: List of mirrored topics, their average latencies and their average record rates

deleteVerifyEmail.description: A valid email address which will be contacted when a cluster delete is requested.

deleteVerifyPhone.description: A valid phone number which will be contacted when a cluster delete is requested.

TwoFactorDeleteConfiguration.description: If present, deleteVerifyEmail or/and deleteVerifyPhone must be included in the request

confirmationPhoneNumber.description: The phone number which will be contacted when the cluster is requested to be delete.

confirmationEmail.description: The email address which will be contacted when the cluster is requested to be deleted.

scheduledStartTime.description: The time this maintenance event should be rescheduled to start at (in UTC time)

displayName.description: Display name of the service user

profile.description:
Profile of the service user
OWNER can manage clusters and users (excluding other service users)
CLUSTER_ADMIN can manage clusters
READ_ONLY can view clusters and access monitoring

administrators.description:
Administrators of the service user. Administrators are standard users that administer the service user.
The administrators can perform operations such as update, manage API keys, and delete on service users they administer.

items.description:
Administrators of the service user. Administrators are standard users that administer the service user.
The administrators can perform operations such as update, manage API keys, and delete on service users they administer.

UpdateServiceUserRequest.description: The fields to update a service user

newTargetLatency.description: The new target latency in milliseconds to set.

domain.description: Domain of the User Action - Account or org

count.description: User action counts for the action kind

UserActionCountForKind.description: Contains information about the User actions count by User action kind

startIndex.description: Starting index for the records to return, useful for pagination. e.g. 10 will return records starting from 11

totalOrgActionCount.description: Count of the total organization actions

counts.description: List of the User actions type by action kind

itemsPerPage.description: Number of records to return per page

totalAccountActionCount.description: Count of the total account actions

domainType.description: Domain of the User Action - Account or org

userName.description: userName who performed the user action

UserActionSummaryResponse.description: Contains details of an user action

id.description: The unique identifier for this user.

displayName.description: The user's preferred name for communication.

UserDetailsResponse.description: The details of the current user.

user.description: Target user name or email address

clientEncryption.description: Accepts true/false. Enables Client ⇄ Node Encryption.

passwordAuth.description: Accepts true/false. Enables Password Authentication and User Authorization.

masterNodes.description: The number of Valkey Master Nodes to be created.

replicaNodes.description: The number of Valkey Replica Nodes to be created.

advertisedHostName.description: Advertised HostName is required for PrivateLink.

description.example: Cluster managed by the integration team.

resizeSettings.description: Settings to determine how resize requests will be performed for the cluster.

pciComplianceMode.description: Creates a PCI compliant cluster, see [PCI Compliance](https://www.instaclustr.com/support/documentation/useful-information/pci-compliance/).

valkeyVersion.description: Version of Valkey to run on the cluster. Available versions:

description.example: Cluster managed by the integration team.

privateNetworkCluster.description: Creates the cluster with private network only, see [Private Network Clusters](https://www.instaclustr.com/support/documentation/useful-information/private-network-clusters/).

passwordAndUserAuth.description: Enables Password Authentication and User Authorization.

resizeSettings.description: Settings to determine how resize requests will be performed for the cluster.

id.description: ID of the cluster.

ValkeyClusterV2.description: Definition of a managed Valkey cluster that can be provisioned in Instaclustr.

replicationFactor.description: The number of replica nodes that should be assigned for each master node.

deletedNodes.description: List of deleted nodes in the data centre

awsSettings.description: AWS specific settings for the Data Centre. Cannot be provided with GCP or Azure settings.
awsSettings.x-insta-comment: due to a bug with the terraform provider openapi plugin this has to be a list instead of a nested object. Also has to be computed because terraform defaults lists to empty arrays when skipped, whereas the API returns null

tagManagementEnabled.description: (Optional) Enable tag management for the data centre, allowing you to create, update and delete custom tags on the data centre via Instaclustr Terraform Provider v2, Cluster Management API or Management Console. Tag management is only available for RIYOA clusters and cannot be disabled once enabled. If not specified, the current value will remain unchanged.

networks.description: All network CIDR blocks for this data centre, including the primary network and any expanded secondary CIDRs.

network.description: The private network address block for the Data Centre specified using CIDR address notation. The network must have a prefix length between `/16` and `/26` and must be part of a private address space.

tags.description: List of tags to apply to the Data Centre. Tags are metadata labels which allow you to identify, categorize and filter clusters. This can be useful for grouping together clusters into applications, environments, or any category that you require. Note: Tags will be returned sorted by key in alphabetical order regardless of input order. Terraform users: `tag` is not supported in terraform lifecycle `ignore_changes`.

zeroInboundAccess.description: Zero Inbound Access gateways eliminate the requirement for any public IP addresses in cluster deployment.

gcpSettings.description: GCP specific settings for the Data Centre. Cannot be provided with AWS or Azure settings.

nodes.description: List of non-deleted nodes in the data centre

azureSettings.description: Azure specific settings for the Data Centre. Cannot be provided with AWS or GCP settings.

masterNodes.description: Total number of master nodes in the Data Centre. In order to maintain quorum on the cluster, you must specify an odd number of master nodes.

name.description: A logical name for the data centre within a cluster. These names must be unique in the cluster.

replicaNodes.description: Total number of replica nodes in the Data Centre.

id.description: ID of the Cluster Data Centre.

region.description: Region of the Data Centre. See the description for node size for a compatible Data Centre for a given node size.

privateLink.description: Create a PrivateLink enabled cluster, see [PrivateLink](https://www.instaclustr.com/support/documentation/useful-information/privatelink/).

providerAccountName.description: For customers running in their own account. Your provider account can be found on the Create Cluster page on the Instaclustr Console, or the "Provider Account" property on any existing cluster. For customers provisioning on Instaclustr's cloud provider accounts, this property may be omitted.

ValkeyUserPasswordV2.description: Definition of a Valkey User Password Update to be applied to a Valkey user.

valkeyUsers.description: List of all Valkey users in the cluster.

ValkeyUserSummariesV2.description: A listable data source of all Valkey users within a Valkey Cluster.

id.description: Instaclustr identifier for the Valkey user. The value of this property has the form: [cluster-id]_[valkey-username]

ValkeyUserSummaryV2.description: Summary of a Valkey User to be applied to a Valkey cluster.

id.description: Instaclustr identifier for the Valkey user. The value of this property has the form: [cluster-id]_[valkey-username]

initialPermissions.description: Permissions initially granted to Valkey user upon creation.

ValkeyUserV2.description: Definition of a Valkey User to be applied to a Valkey cluster.

id.description: Unique Id for this exclusion windows

clusterId.description: Cluster Id for the cluster that this exclusion window relates to

dayOfWeek.description: The day of the week that this exclusion window starts on

startHour.description: The hour of the day that this exclusion window starts on

durationInHours.description: The duration (in hours) of this exclusion window

WindowResponse.description: List of exclusion windows for the given cluster

cloudProvider.description: The provider of the Zero Inbound Access gateway.

name.description: The name of the Zero Inbound Access gateway.

id.description: ID of the Zero Inbound Access gateway.

region.description: The region of the Zero Inbound Access gateway.

status.description: The status of the Zero Inbound Access gateway.

tags.description: List of tags to apply to the Data Centre. Tags are metadata labels which  allow you to identify, categorize and filter clusters. This can be useful for grouping together clusters into applications, environments, or any category that you require. Note `tag` is not supported in terraform lifecycle `ignore_changes`.

ZeroInboundAccessGatewayV2.description: Zero Inbound Access gateways eliminate the requirement for any public IP addresses in cluster deployment.

name.description: Name of the connector. Could be one of [Mirror Connector, Checkpoint Connector].

Basic Authentication.description:
Most requests to the API must use Basic Authentication and contain a valid username and appropriate API key for the endpoint.

API keys can be retrieved any time from the console. To find the API key relevant to the endpoint, refer to the Authentication & Rate Limit section for the endpoint or the group of the endpoint.

No Authentication.description: Certain endpoints are publicly available and does not need any authentication to access.
